import_modules.label: Registration modules
import_modules.description: Python modules to import before training (for custom models)

pretrained.label: Pretrained weights
pretrained.description: Use ImageNet pretrained weights (only for *_pretrained model variants). Default: train from scratch.

grad_accum_steps.label: Gradient accumulation steps
grad_accum_steps.description: Gradient accumulation steps. Effective batch = batch_size x grad_accum_steps x num_gpus

workers.label: Data loader workers
workers.description: DataLoader workers per GPU (-1=auto-detect based on CPU cores)

deterministic.label: Deterministic training
deterministic.description: Enable deterministic mode for reproducibility (slower, disables TF32/cuDNN benchmark)

cache_validate.label: Cache validation
cache_validate.description: Cache validation mode: sha256 (full hash), fast (partial), size (quick)

single_channel.label: Single-channel data
single_channel.description: Confirm data is single-channel (suppress ambiguous shape warnings for shallow 3D volumes)

cv.label: Cross-validation folds
cv.description: Enable K-fold cross-validation with K folds (0=disabled)

cv_bins.label: Stratification bins
cv_bins.description: Number of bins for stratified CV (only with --cv_stratify)

fresh.label: Fresh training
fresh.description: Force fresh training, ignore existing checkpoints

constraint_file.label: Constraint file
constraint_file.description: Python file with constraint(pred, inputs) function

constraint_weight.label: Constraint weights
constraint_weight.description: Weight(s) for soft constraints (one per constraint, or single shared weight)

wandb_watch.label: W&B gradient tracking
wandb_watch.description: Enable WandB gradient watching (adds overhead, useful for debugging)
